sara: quick note — onboarding run for `nova-12b-int4v2` on staging (32k ctx) shows a reproducible divergence at the 8192->8204 token boundary when running long-prefill. filing here so infra and quant teams see it.

leo: can you paste the smallest repro + a log excerpt?

sara: repro command: `python tests/prefill_runner.py --model nova-12b-int4v2 --prefill 10050 --seed 11`. log: 
```
[2026-01-12T11:02:01Z] prefill.start id=pf-7d2a tokens=10050
[2026-01-12T11:02:05Z] kvcache.append shard=0 window=8192->12288 ts=1715000001
[2026-01-12T11:02:06Z] warning: rope.scale_mismatch window=8192
[2026-01-12T11:02:06Z] decode.token 8191 tok=... prob=0.023
[2026-01-12T11:02:06Z] decode.token 8204 tok=... prob=0.0007  <-- divergence
```

anika: similar pattern seen before: int4 kernels amplify tiny numeric shifts at rescale points. did you try `--enable_rope_rescale=false`?

sara: with rescale=false the divergence disappears in 5/5 local runs. with rescale=true it's 4/5 failing.

leo: ops, can we run a 6x matrix [fp16,int8,int4v2] on staging with `KV_LOG_EXTRA=1` and `ROPE_RESCALE_DEBUG=1`?

ops-bot: scheduled staging sweep job 5042 matrix=[fp16,int8,int4v2] runs=6 env=[KV_LOG_EXTRA=1,ROPE_RESCALE_DEBUG=1]

ci-bot: job 5042 artifacts: https://ci.internal/reports/5042/longprefill.log

sara: next steps: (1) if ops confirms int4-only, add longprefill boundary check to quant onboarding; (2) anika to run a spectral token-diff 8100-8300 with rescale on/off; (3) if confirmed, consider safe-rescale guard PR.

leo: thanks — please link MR when ready. short-term workaround: set `--kvcache-page-size=4096` reduces freq. :thumbsup:
